Definition: from G2914; a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete:--Crete, Cretian.
BiblicalUsage: Cretes are the people of Crete, and they appear at Pentecost in Acts 2:11, hearing the wonderful works of God in their own tongues, and again in Titus 1:12, where Paul quotes a Cretan prophet saying "The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the two verses belong together: the gospel reached even a people with that reputation, and Paul still left Titus there to set the churches in order.
